summary: Confirmed target: Android via 5G/Internet controls ESP32-WROOM-32 robot indoors via home 2.4GHz Wi-Fi, no cellular modem/Bluetooth. Architecture React Native Android app over authenticated WSS to persistent Node.js TypeScript server (one-driver session), server publishes MQTT/TLS to cloud EMQX, ESP32 subscribes and drives two TT gear motors. Final starter hardware: ESP32 DevKit 30-pin, 2WD kit incl motors/wheels/caster, DRV8833 (chosen over earlier TB6612 to accommodate 4x NiMH battery voltage), 4xAA rechargeable NiMH plus proper charger, USB 5V powerbank for ESP32, common GND, switch/fuse, wiring, filter capacitor. GPIO25/26 AIN1/2, GPIO27/33 BIN1/2; verify module /SLEEP wiring and motor stall current. MQTT QoS0 retain=false, 5-10 Hz commands, onboard ~500ms watchdog defaults stopped on disconnection/boot; TLS verified and per-device ACL, no public router port. Cloud guidance: EMQX Serverless current free quota; HiveMQ Serverless retiring Dec 31 2026. Estimated parts ~450-750k VND without USB bank, camera/cloud. For remote out-of-sight operation need live camera coverage; keep controlled flat clear area. Next: select exact parts/pinout and implement firmware/backend/mobile application with tests.
